tools.name: check_website
tools.description: One-off check of whether a website is up right now, from OhSnap's probe network. Works without an account. Use when the user asks "is my site down?", "is X up?", or wants a status code, response time, or the reason a site fails (DNS failure, SSL error, timeout, HTTP error, Cloudflare edge error). Re

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Returns the OhSnap account this MCP key belongs to: email, plan (Free, Unlimited, Agency), the monitor cap, and the fastest allowed check interval. Call before add_monitor to explain plan limits up front.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: Lists every website this OhSnap account monitors, with its current status (up, down, warning, pending), last response time, and check interval. Use to answer "are my sites up?" and to find a website_id for other tools.

tools.name: add_monitor
tools.description: Adds a website to OhSnap so it is checked around the clock and the user is alerted when it goes down or comes back. Free accounts can monitor 5 sites every 5 minutes; Unlimited allows any number every 30 seconds. Pass alert_email if the account has no alert channel yet, otherwise the monitor will ru

tools.name: get_incidents
tools.description: Returns recent outages for one monitored website: when each started and ended, how long it lasted, and the error. On the Unlimited plan each incident includes an AI diagnosis in plain language; on Free it is marked ai_locked.

tools.name: send_test_alert
tools.description: Sends a clearly labelled test DOWN alert through every alert channel linked to a monitor (email, SMS, WhatsApp, Slack, Telegram), so the user can confirm alerts reach them. Limited to one test per monitor per minute.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "add_monitor" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Adds a website to OhSnap so it is checked around the clock and the user is alerted when it goes down or comes back. Free accounts can monitor 5 sites every 5 mi…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: whoami · Public sink: whoami, add_monitor, send_test_alert · Destructive: check_website, add_monitor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: whoami · Public sink: whoami, add_monitor, send_test_alert · Destructive: check_website, add_monitor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
